What was changed in Insomnia FangSong
-------------------------------------
* Added Simplified-Chinese hanzi missing from HZ Socho, and converted the
  existing GB2312 hanzi from Japanese (JIS) glyph forms to mainland-China
  (GB / 新字形) forms. All Chinese hanzi are rendered from GlyphWiki's
  mainland (-g) regional data via the KAGE engine, then traced to outlines.
* Renamed to 不寐仿宋 / Insomnia FangSong; converted to TrueType (glyf) for
  broad application compatibility; fixed vertical metrics; reorganised the
  naming into a Book / Demi / Bold family.
* Non-Chinese glyphs (Latin, Greek, Cyrillic, kana, symbols, punctuation)
  are carried over unchanged from HZ Socho.

6. Build tools — KAGE engine (GPL-3.0) and Potrace (GPL-2.0-or-later)
========================================================================
The Chinese hanzi were produced by rendering GlyphWiki's freely-licensed

result with Potrace (https://potrace.sourceforge.net/, GNU GPL v2 or later).

These are BUILD TOOLS. None of their program code is contained in or

This position rests on two grounds:

  (a) The GNU GPL version 3, section 0, states that "the output from running

  (b) The same position is taken upstream. HZ Socho is generated in exactly
      the same way — KAGE engine and Potrace applied to GlyphWiki data — yet

(sections 1-5) rather than the GPL.
